Name: JadeMemoryMachine
Author: moyan111222
Description:
[list]
[*]📷 [b]Photo Album[/b] — Character-sorted image viewer with full-screen page browsing[/*]
[*]🎬 [b]Animation Player[/b] — Sprite-sheet playback with smooth frame cycling[/*]
[*]🎮 [b]Full Controls[/b] — Pause / Resume, speed toggle (0.5× / 1× / 2×), previous / next animation[/*]
[*]📂 [b]Smart Browsing[/b] — Two-level menu: pick a Character, then a Category (Blowjob / Cowgirl / Missionary / Doggy / Other)[/*]
[*]⚡ [b]Lightning Fast[/b] — Lazy-loaded: menus open instantly, only the current image or frame is loaded[/*]
[*]🪑 [b]Buy at Robin's[/b] — Available in the furniture catalogue[/*]
[/list]        [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Loki101idk]Loki101idk[/url] The animations and pictures of this mod all come from this guy。   [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/SerDakota]SerDakota[/url] for making the Pretty Anime Portrait
